text: Done on main: task defined and guarded (f484161f, 2ab12ea7, 32e6a62f), pre-seal audit (968904a2), condition-stratified seal 63 test / 60 dev (8ad71755) with per-condition power and a zero-read ledger (docs/data/memento/test-split.json). Deviation from the original AC: eligibility is the frozen row rule in task-definition.json (the seven non-integer RecallType cells are excluded by that rule, not by id), and conditions are reported separately rather than the descriptor designating condition 1 as the transfer test and condition 4 as its control. Any condition-1-vs-4 contrast must be declared in the Phase 3 release-candidate manifest before the opening.
